clients.name: Gilsulate International
clients.intro: A few directions for the new Gilsulate website. Open each one, click around, and try it on your phone too.

options.title: Option 1
options.subtitle: Industrial, dark and technical
options.notes: Bold engineering look with heat-orange accents. Full site: product, systems, tech info, case studies, news, about and contact.

options.title: Option 2
options.subtitle: Photo-led editorial
options.notes: Large site photography, big modern type and a full-screen menu. Project pages read as stories. Same full set of pages.

options.title: Option 3
options.subtitle: Clean and bright
options.notes: Light corporate look in the logo blue and red, with daylight photography and a role picker for owners, engineers, contractors, EPC firms and military. Same full set of pages.
